name: approval-queue
description: A named list of proposals with unique ids. A change to a proposal or its actor requires a new binding. A pending decision keeps its bound values and key until a receipt or cancel ends it. An approval mark shows a decision. A badge shows other states. A polite status gives each receipt result.

parts.name: action-button-button
parts.description: Button that starts an approval or a rejection.

parts.name: action-button-cancel
parts.description: Button that cancels a confirmation or a pending action.

parts.name: action-button-copy
parts.description: Button that copies a receipt reference.

parts.name: action-button-retry
parts.description: Button that tries a pending decision again.

parts.name: approval-mark
parts.description: Approved or rejected decision with visible text and a group name.

parts.name: announcement
parts.description: Polite status for changes to item states.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Message when the list is empty.

parts.name: state
parts.description: State of the item and the reason from a failed receipt.

parts.name: summary
parts.description: Summary of the proposal as text.

parts.name: title
parts.description: Title of the proposal as text.
